# AI-Assisted Evidence Synthesis for Marketing Decisions

**Marketing Analytics · MSDM CEP**

## Overview

A culminating experience project examining the use of AI-assisted evidence synthesis and meta-analysis in marketing research.

## Managerial challenge

Marketing decision-makers need timely, trustworthy synthesis across studies rather than relying on one finding.

## Approach and methods

Study screening, structured effect coding, human/AI coding comparisons, and quantitative meta-analysis when eligible effect-size data are available.

## Outcomes and status

The project is in progress. Final effect estimates and validation results will be added after verification.

## My contribution

This was a coursework or team project. Specific individual contributions and final results will be clarified before public publication.
